notablePrerequisites: Your opponents collectively control at least six tapped lands.
description:
Cast Mana Geyser by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Mana Geyser and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Mana Geyser, adding at least six {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
